item: P33-5 WALLS + LAMBDA AND MAGNETIC FIELD
units: margins/deficits in geometric 1/m^2 (programme audit units); c^4/G = 1.210310e+44 J/m^3 per 1/m^2

deficit_sources.D1: REPORT.md 1.2 (recorded): closest beta=0.1 near-miss -2.06e-7, named families
deficit_sources.D3: p335_rerun.py this item: unoptimised profiles at beta=0.1 fail (A-profile worst -1.0; frontier-like (5,10) M=1.915 worst SEC -3.70e-3, DEC -2.17e-6) — corroborates D2 scale; pricing uses D1/D2, the smallest (most augmentation-friendly) deficits

lambda.note: Lambda is NEC-neutral and DEC-saturating exactly (rho+p=0, rho-|p|=0); its only nonzero EC shift is SEC-negative (-2 rho_L). It cannot cover an NEC/DEC deficit at any magnitude; priced below on magnitude anyway.

magnetic.EM_EC_alone: NEC: 2rho_EM (perp) / 0 (along B); WEC: rho_EM; SEC: >=0; DEC: 0 (saturated). EM alone is EC-legal, but its DEC margin contribution is exactly 0 in its own eigenframe and its NEC contribution along B is exactly 0.

D1_record_closest_nearmiss.note_Melvin: uniform B => Melvin asymptotics, not asymptotically flat; flux-tube/curvature scale ~1/B_geom as listed, i.e. only ~10-20x the shell radii.

D2_record_tail_DEC.note_Melvin: uniform B => Melvin asymptotics, not asymptotically flat; flux-tube/curvature scale ~1/B_geom as listed, i.e. only ~10-20x the shell radii.

D3_rerun_frontierlike_DEC.note_Melvin: uniform B => Melvin asymptotics, not asymptotically flat; flux-tube/curvature scale ~1/B_geom as listed, i.e. only ~10-20x the shell radii.

tail_worked_example.site: conditions-first tail, rho~0, p_r=+1.8e-6 geom, p_t~0
tail_worked_example.orientation: B tension axis along r (locally optimal)
tail_worked_example.caveat: DEC_t saturates at exactly 0 (uncertifiable, same status as the record's +1.3e-9 tiebreak); and a single UNIFORM B cannot be radial everywhere on a spherical shell (radial B = monopole, div B != 0): uniform B is radial only at the poles, tangential at the equator, where its +rho_EM pressure ADDS to the radial pressure and worsens radial DEC there. The priced B is therefore a lower bound for one uniform field.

verdicts.a_lambda: AUGMENTED-FAIL — measured Lambda is NEC/DEC-neutral by identity (rho+p=0) and SEC-negative; on magnitude alone it is 46.7 orders short of the smallest recorded deficit (D1) and 47.6 orders short of D2.
verdicts.b_magnetic: AUGMENTED-FAIL — covering even the smallest recorded deficit (D1) needs B = 7.92e+15 T (12.9 orders above the 1e3 T pulsed bar, 6.3 orders above Schwinger Bc); D2 needs 2.34e+16 T. Plus Melvin (non-asymptotically-flat) asymptotics and the uniform-B/monopole orientation obstruction.
